arguments.code:
text = """**Cybersecurity in the Digital Age: Challenges, Strategies, and Future Directions**  

*Word count: ≈ 1,620*

---

### Introduction  

The twenty‑first century has been defined by an unprecedented surge in digital connectivity. From cloud‑based services that power global commerce to the Internet‑of‑Things (IoT) devices that monitor our homes and cities, virtually every facet of modern life now depends on information systems. This reliance brings extraordinary benefits—speed, efficiency, and the democratization of knowledge—but it also creates a fertile ground for malicious actors."""
import unicodedata, collections
non_ascii = collections.Counter(c for c in text if ord(c) > 127)
for c, n in non_ascii.items():
    print(repr(c), hex(ord(c)), unicodedata.name(c, '?'), n)
print('---lines---')
for line in text.splitlines():
    bad = [(c, hex(ord(c))) for c in line if ord(c) > 127]
    if bad:
        print(repr(line[:60]), bad)
